    o_ref[...] += jax.lax.dot_general(x_ref[...].astype(jnp.float32), w_ref[...].astype(jnp.float32), (((1,), (1,)), ((), ())), preferred_element_type=jnp.float32)

    @pl.when(pl.program_id(1) == pl.num_programs(1) - 1)
    def _():
        ch = _tile(o_ref.shape[0], 256)
        for r in range(0, o_ref.shape[0], ch):
            y = o_ref[pl.ds(r, ch), :]
            y = jnp.tanh(y)
            y = y - jnp.mean(y, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
            o_ref[pl.ds(r, ch), :] = y.astype(o_ref.dtype)


def workload(x, w):
    M, K = x.shape
    N = w.shape[0]
    # rows per block decide the speed; at N = 8192 the whole-row blocks need a smaller K tile to fit
    tm, tk = _tile(M, 1024), _tile(K, 512 if N <= 4096 else 256)
    # the weight block and every per-feature vector span all of N: the row reduction must see whole rows
    return pl.pallas_call(
        _kernel,
        out_shape=jax.ShapeDtypeStruct((M, N), x.dtype),
        grid=(M // tm, K // tk),
        in_specs=[pl.BlockSpec((tm, tk), lambda i, l: (i, l)), pl.BlockSpec((N, tk), lambda i, l: (0, l))],
        out_specs=pl.BlockSpec((tm, N), lambda i, l: (i, 0)),
        compiler_params=pltpu.CompilerParams(dimension_semantics=("parallel", "arbitrary"), vmem_limit_bytes=VMEM_LIMIT),
    )(x, w)
